create_episodic_logger: create an EpisodicLogger with EpisodicLoggerConfig specifying agent_id, task_id, action_spec, and timestep_spec to record robot episodes
reset_logger_for_episode: reset the EpisodicLogger with an initial dm_env.TimeStep to start recording a new episode
record_action_and_timestep: record an action and next timestep pair using record_action_and_next_timestep to log each step of the episode
write_and_stop_logger: call write then stop on the EpisodicLogger to flush episode data to MCAP files and clean up resources
set_task_id_between_episodes: set a new task_id on the EpisodicLogger between episodes using set_task_id to reassign the current task
